startup_sequence: Read this file from current main.

Read SYSTEM-TOPOLOGY-004.json. Active peer systems are CORE, LEARNING, BOOK and DOCUMENTS. PROSE is an active child specialist of BOOK at SYSTEM_MASTER/BOOK/PROSE and is not a peer system or separate owner lane.
Read system_catalog before broad project/system rediscovery. The catalog is a discovery/reuse index and never overrides topology authority.
When the user asks to build or resume a known future system/candidate, resolve its system packet before broad archive archaeology. For Programming, read programming_system_packet first.
For a System Master root chat read master_root_chat_contract. For CORE, LEARNING, BOOK or DOCUMENTS owner chats read owner_chat_contract.

Resolve requested work to SYSTEM_MASTER product-root governance, SYSTEM_MASTER/CORE, SYSTEM_MASTER/LEARNING, SYSTEM_MASTER/BOOK including its PROSE child, SYSTEM_MASTER/DOCUMENTS, shared infrastructure, a cataloged non-active candidate, or UNALLOCATED.

Fetch every relevant live canonical control_ref. PROSE uses literary-prose-engine-001 but executes under BOOK owner-lane control. DOCUMENTS uses documents/control-v1. Do not infer a live head from chat memory, morning packets, census seals or stale topology records.

Read the current completion ledger before repeating work and the authority-selected obligation registry before choosing what remains. Registry 006 and earlier are historical current-state evidence only after Registry 007 admission.

SYSTEM-MASTER-KNOWLEDGE-RECOVERY-001 is the current central objective. Its semantic owner is SYSTEM_MASTER product-root governance; CORE administers execution because shared custody/A-01 infrastructure is Core-administered. This split does not create a Programming peer system or a SYSTEM_MASTER root worker lane.

Read knowledge_recovery_supervised_acceptance before evaluating Knowledge Recovery standing. The topology-004 Programming proving pipeline passed twice deterministically on exact subject 4a2d4f7168f48728ef67d187ff43afb97c9568d9 and is accepted for deterministic Second Shift custody recovery/preparation.

Knowledge Recovery Second Shift eligibility does not imply A-01 overnight admission. The current registered qualification remains overnight_eligible=false unless the authority-selected A-01 registry/policy is explicitly changed. Do not bypass that gate.

Read knowledge_recovery_next_contract. Resolve the 26 external-byte-pending and 2 identity-unproven Programming pilot records to exact staged bytes or durable explicit blockers; create Manifest 003 rather than rewriting Manifest 001/002.
Read the selected expectation_registry and reallocation_ledger; prior versions remain historical evidence and may not override current topology.
SYSTEM_MASTER/BOOK/PROSE is a valid active child authority path. It never receives an independent peer-system or Second Shift mutation lane; scheduling and execution control inherit the BOOK lane.

For Documents work read the current tool-owner allocation 003, Documents control record, Document admission and source-custody records. Documents is a first-class peer tool system even though execution is headless through Chat.

BOOK and DOCUMENTS are peers. BOOK owns canonical book/manuscript/lifecycle/author state and the PROSE literary-specialist child. DOCUMENTS owns document/artifact mechanics and generic document services.
Historical Prose exact-SHA/hosted/A-01/private/blind/author evidence remains valid only for its exact historical boundary and never transfers to changed Book-Prose integration subjects.

Second Shift active owner lanes are discovered from SECOND-SHIFT-REGISTRY-001 owner_files and currently are CORE, LEARNING, BOOK and DOCUMENTS. The historical standalone PROSE lane and temporary SYSTEM_MASTER root worker lane remain retired; active PROSE child work routes through BOOK.

When Documents completes/supersedes/materially changes its objective, reconcile DOCUMENTS-DELEGATIONS.json in the same working session and select the next Documents-owned successor. Book-Prose literary integration does not transfer to Documents.
When Book or its Prose child completes/supersedes/materially changes its objective, reconcile BOOK-DELEGATIONS.json in the same working session against the exact live Book control head.

For historical/archive reuse, read archive_source_registry, knowledge_recovery_control, the requested system packet and its current ingest manifest. A-01 may verify presented bytes, manifests, schemas, provenance and exact-subject qualification but may not create or promote system identity.
Previously closed research receives the comparative/material delta gate from the historical research method; do not restart it unless current evidence supports a material reopen trigger.
Check the latest System State Reconciler and topology-validator standing before repository-wide current-state claims.
Human, author, private-data, external-authority, A-01, native-platform, publication and production boundaries remain explicit and cannot be synthesized by topology migration or catalog ingestion.

truth_classes.AUTHORITY_CURRENT: Active owner, live control head, current state and evidence agree under topology 004.
truth_classes.AUTHORITY_DELTA: Live active owner state moved after the last sealed checkpoint or packet; reconcile only the delta.
truth_classes.RETIRED_PROSE_PEER_LANE_STALE_WORK: Metadata attempts to recreate PROSE as an independent peer owner or separate mutation lane. Preserve historical evidence, but route active child work through BOOK.
truth_classes.CATALOG_CANDIDATE_ONLY: A cataloged future system/capability is discoverable but has not been admitted into active topology and has no active owner authority.
truth_classes.ARCHIVE_IDENTITY_UNPROVEN: Historical material is referenced but exact presented bytes/digest/custody are unavailable or conflicting; preserve as a gap/quarantine rather than infer identity.
truth_classes.EXTERNAL_BYTES_PENDING: A source has a stable external locator and may have a pre-stage digest, but A-01 has not actually observed the bytes and cannot call them verified.
truth_classes.STAGED_EXACT_BYTES: Exact source bytes have been observed and immutably staged with digest/custody evidence, but A-01 verification remains separate until A-01 reads that exact subject.
truth_classes.UNALLOCATED: Work cannot be mapped to a current active owner path or cataloged candidate boundary.
truth_classes.STALE_DELEGATION: Second Shift delegation does not match current active owner control head or current open objective.
truth_classes.EVIDENCE_MISMATCH: Claimed standing exceeds or conflicts with exact receipt/artifact/subject evidence.
truth_classes.HUMAN_DECISION_REQUIRED: Machine-readable authority cannot select among valid product choices.
truth_classes.AUTHOR_DECISION_REQUIRED: Progress requires author authority automation cannot synthesize.
truth_classes.PRIVATE_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED: Progress requires private data authority that is not currently granted.
truth_classes.NATIVE_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED: Progress requires native Apple/device evidence not available from hosted execution.
truth_classes.EXTERNAL_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED: Progress requires external provider/publication/certification authority not granted by repository evidence.

write_rules: Historical evidence, manifests and exact-SHA receipts are append-only; supersession and catalog normalization never rewrite them.

Open current work belongs in the authority-selected obligation registry under exactly one executable owner path, with separate semantic_owner_path when product-root governance retains decision authority.
PROSE is active only as SYSTEM_MASTER/BOOK/PROSE, has no independent canonical manuscript-write authority and executes through BOOK owner-lane control.
Documents is first-class and receives the same control/delegation/reconciliation treatment as Learning and Book, but does not own Book-specific Prose literary intelligence.
Any new first-class system or parent relationship requires explicit user instruction and a superseding topology ADR/registry version; a catalog candidate cannot self-promote.
Second Shift active lane discovery comes from the registry, not a hard-coded list. PROSE child work inherits BOOK and does not create a fifth peer lane.
The supervised Knowledge Recovery pipeline is accepted for deterministic Second Shift custody recovery/preparation; this does not alter A-01 overnight admission policy.
External or Library bytes become A01_VERIFIED only when A-01 actually reads the exact staged bytes in an admitted qualification.
Changed Book-Prose integration bytes require fresh evidence; historical Prose PASS does not transfer.
BOOK canonical writes remain BOOK-owned even when BOOK consumes PROSE child intelligence or DOCUMENTS document services.
Generated system packets are discovery caches/views. Their claims must remain traceable to source registry/catalog evidence and current authority.
A-01 catalog processing emits receipts/attestations and deterministic facts only; ambiguous semantic ownership remains an explicit decision rather than automated promotion.
